_comment: Published repository name -> local checkout directory name, for tools/dev.py only.
assets/modules.json stays canonical and describes the PUBLISHED platform: every
destination is an absolute GitHub Pages URL whose first path segment is the repo
name. dev.py rewrites those to local paths, and until now it assumed the checkout
on disk was named exactly like the repo. That is not always true — a module's
content can move to a differently named repository while the published URL, owned
by someone else, still points at the old one.
This file records those cases, and only those cases. A repo absent from `map`
resolves to a directory of its own name, exactly as before — so adding this file
changed nothing for any module already working.
Directory names only. Never absolute paths: --root supplies the location, so this
file stays portable across machines and must contain nothing user-specific.

_evidence.foodbridge-inventory-mockup: Both destinations published under this repo — screens/inventory/screen-01-current-stock.html and screens/raw-material-inventory/screen-01-live-stock.html — resolve inside foodbridge-module-inventory-management/discovery/. Verified by locating the files, not inferred from the names.
